reason: The original full-resolution Cosmos worker had unbounded visual-token memory and impractical runtime. The run was stopped before further Cosmos combinations were accepted.

quarantined_results.reason: Cosmos outputs were generated under the retired full-resolution execution policy and cannot be mixed with the amended protocol.

memory_observation.conclusion: Process exit reliably releases retained CUDA and host allocations; bounded subprocesses are the cleanup boundary.

selected_execution_policy.maximum_detections_provenance: Highest total GT-box count in any MTSD test image (grp8_06980edd-front.jpg)
selected_execution_policy.box_coordinate_space: Predictions are decoded on the model's normalized 0..1000 grid and mapped back to original image dimensions before scoring.

rejected_candidate.Cosmos_Reason2_2B_1024: Rejected because TP fell from 2 to 0 on the primary validation slice.
rejected_candidate.Cosmos_Reason2_8B_2560: Rejected because visual context saturated the 24 GB GPU and restored impractical per-image latency.

wandb.resume_behavior: W&B tombstones deleted IDs, so the corrected coordinator publishes to the fresh versioned replacement ID while retaining the same project/display name. Only compatible preserved combinations plus newly recomputed Cosmos results are included.
